schema_corrections_v1_1: Completed period and perimeter on all 79 claims.
Quarantined four answer-key claims from the live claim register and moved grading status to explicit flags.
Replaced free-form position dependency labels with five closed relation types.
Separated epistemic and decision status at IC.

definitions.name: FY2025 revenue
definitions.meaning: Revenue recognized for FY2025 on the historical accounting basis.

definitions.name: Seller-adjusted EBITDA
definitions.meaning: Reported EBITDA plus seller-proposed adjustments, including run-rate pricing and utilization initiatives.

definitions.name: QoE normalized EBITDA
definitions.meaning: Historical EBITDA after adjustments accepted by the independent QoE provider.

definitions.name: Firm-underwritten EBITDA
definitions.meaning: QoE-informed earnings basis after additional Firm reserves and recurring post-close costs.

definitions.name: Covenant EBITDA
definitions.meaning: EBITDA calculated under the credit-agreement definition, including permitted certified add-backs and excluding non-permitted items.

definitions.name: Customer concentration - billing account
definitions.meaning: Revenue concentration calculated by individual billing account.

definitions.name: Customer concentration - ultimate parent
definitions.meaning: Revenue concentration aggregated across billing accounts controlled by the same ultimate parent.

definitions.name: Recurring or repeat revenue - seller classification
definitions.meaning: Scheduled/programmatic revenue plus repeat-project revenue under management's classification.

definitions.name: Expected recurring revenue - project schedule
definitions.meaning: Project-level expected recurring revenue identified in the project schedule; not equivalent to management's recurring-or-repeat classification.

definitions.name: Normalized operating working capital
definitions.meaning: Operating working-capital target after normalization for payroll accruals, aged WIP, billing delays, deferred revenue and timing.

definitions.name: Economic net debt
definitions.meaning: Gross funded debt and debt-like items less unrestricted cash for purchase-price and equity value purposes.

definitions.name: Covenant net debt
definitions.meaning: Gross debt less eligible cash subject to the credit-agreement cash-netting cap.

definitions.name: Standalone base return
definitions.meaning: Sponsor gross MOIC and XIRR on the standalone base operating case, excluding unidentified acquisitions.

definitions.name: Standalone downside return
definitions.meaning: Sponsor gross MOIC and XIRR on the standalone downside case.

questions.question: Which billing accounts share common parent-company relationships?
questions.tests: Tests whether customer concentration is understated by account-level reporting
questions.resolution: Seven Riverton accounts aggregate to 18.2% parent exposure.

questions.question: What percentage of revenue is generated by the largest parent customer across all billing accounts?
questions.tests: Tests parent-level concentration and downside exposure
questions.resolution: Riverton represents 18.2% of revenue.

questions.question: Which customer agreements have minimum-volume commitments, and which can be reduced or terminated on short notice?
questions.tests: Tests durability of revenue and contractual protection
questions.resolution: Riverton has no minimum volume and 60-day termination rights; risk accepted with conditions.

questions.question: How much revenue is scheduled/programmatic versus repeat-project versus new/discrete project work?
questions.tests: Tests the quality of the 72% recurring-or-repeat claim
questions.resolution: 38% scheduled/programmatic and 34% repeat; repeat is not contractually recurring.

questions.question: Which top customers have non-standard pricing, margin or service-level terms?
questions.tests: Tests customer profitability and service risk
questions.resolution: No complete top-customer pricing/margin term analysis is included.

questions.question: Which EBITDA adjustments are implemented, supportable and non-recurring?
questions.tests: Tests sustainability of adjusted EBITDA
questions.resolution: Firm underwrites $11.4m after accepted adjustments and reserves.

questions.question: What is the support for the pricing and utilization initiative add-back?
questions.tests: Tests whether run-rate operational improvements are historical earnings
questions.resolution: Pricing and utilization initiatives are forecast-only and receive no historical add-back.

questions.question: What is the correct normalized working-capital target?
questions.tests: Tests cash-free/debt-free economics and purchase-price adjustment
questions.resolution: Normalized NWC target is $8.4m.

questions.question: What portion of unbilled WIP is aged, disputed or missing customer approval?
questions.tests: Tests collectability and revenue quality
questions.resolution: Aged/review WIP is material and excluded from NWC support; monthly monitoring required.

questions.question: Which liabilities are debt-like and which are ordinary working-capital items?
questions.tests: Tests no double counting between purchase-price schedules
questions.resolution: Net debt and debt-like items are $10.2m.

questions.question: Which time-entry, billing, ERP and customer-master systems are still active?
questions.tests: Tests integration readiness
questions.resolution: Central PSA, Legacy A and Legacy B remain active.

questions.question: What failed or was delayed in prior integrations and systems migrations?
questions.tests: Tests execution risk in the current integration plan
questions.resolution: Integration remained incomplete; detailed history of failed migrations is not included.

questions.question: Who owns the post-close integration program and what is the required cash budget?
questions.tests: Tests management capacity and governance
questions.resolution: A $2.0m plan, dedicated leader and governance are required.

questions.question: How are utilization, rework and project profitability defined across branches?
questions.tests: Tests comparability of operating KPIs
questions.resolution: Recorded and standardized utilization differ; KPI normalization remains a control requirement.

questions.question: Which contracts require change-of-control notice or consent?
questions.tests: Tests closing conditions and customer disruption risk
questions.resolution: Material COC notices/consents require completion before closing.

questions.question: What is the treatment of the founder-related headquarters lease?
questions.tests: Tests related-party economics and lease normalization
questions.resolution: Founder-related HQ lease must be reset to market terms.

questions.question: What EBITDA basis will lenders use for covenant calculations?
questions.tests: Tests financing headroom and covenant definitions
questions.resolution: Covenant EBITDA is $12.2m and distinct from Firm EBITDA.

questions.question: What are the proposed limits on add-backs, cash netting, acquisition capacity and minimum liquidity?
questions.tests: Tests covenant flexibility and downside protection
questions.resolution: Facility limits and covenant rules are specified in the model; signed agreement absent.

questions.question: Which executives and branch leaders require retention arrangements?
questions.tests: Tests post-close continuity
questions.resolution: Sixteen employees are retention-critical; specific arrangements are not included.

questions.question: What board approvals should be required before acquisitions or major systems cutovers?
questions.tests: Tests whether accepted risks will be governed after closing
questions.resolution: Board approvals are required for major cutovers and add-ons.

case_positions.statement: The Firm should acquire Alderstone at no more than $108.0m EV on the approved capital structure and subject to all IC conditions.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Reject, reprice or re-underwrite the transaction.

case_positions.statement: Alderstone is a credible platform in regulated, safety-critical outsourced compliance services.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Weakens the strategic rationale and exit-quality assumption.
case_positions.notes: No external market or commercial diligence report is included in the fixture.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Qualitative platform-quality position; quantified only through downstream growth, margin and exit positions.

case_positions.statement: Revenue is substantially repeat-oriented, but should not be treated as contractually recurring.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Reduces confidence in organic growth, customer durability and leverage capacity.
case_positions.notes: 38% scheduled/programmatic and 34% repeat projects must remain distinct; repeat projects are not contractually recurring. Raw customer/project classifications use other non-equivalent definitions.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Revenue quality directly informs base and downside organic-growth assumptions.

case_positions.statement: The relevant customer concentration measure is ultimate-parent exposure; Riverton represents 18.2%, not 7.6%.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Changes the risk assessment, downside design, monitoring and potentially the supported price.

case_positions.statement: Riverton is sufficiently durable to remain in the base case, but a material reduction belongs in downside and requires ongoing monitoring.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: If treated as base-case impairment, revenue, margin, leverage and returns must be revised.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Riverton durability is represented in downside and combined-risk revenue, margin and sponsor-return cases.

case_positions.statement: The standalone business can sustain approximately 7% organic growth without unidentified acquisitions.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Reduces exit EBITDA, deleveraging and sponsor returns.
case_positions.notes: No external commercial diligence or customer-call corpus is included.

case_positions.statement: EBITDA margin can expand gradually through pricing, utilization and project discipline, but not through unsupported historical add-backs.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Reduces cash flow, leverage paydown and returns.

case_positions.statement: The correct internal valuation and leverage basis is $11.4m of Firm-underwritten EBITDA.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Changes entry multiple, debt capacity, equity requirement, price support and returns.

case_positions.statement: Seller-adjusted EBITDA of $12.7m is not an acceptable underwriting basis.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Using it would overstate earnings and understate entry valuation.

case_positions.statement: QoE-normalized EBITDA of $11.9m is a diligence reference, not the final Firm basis, because the Firm applies additional reserves and recurring-cost adjustments.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Clarifies why external QoE and internal underwriting legitimately differ.

case_positions.statement: Covenant EBITDA of $12.2m is a separate contractual quantity and should not be replaced by the Firm valuation basis.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Affects covenant leverage and headroom but not internal valuation.
case_positions.notes: The signed credit agreement is not included; the model and IC materials are the available basis.

case_positions.statement: The transaction should use an $8.4m normalized NWC target, not the seller's $7.7m proposal.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Changes purchase-price true-up, cash requirements and opening balance sheet.

case_positions.statement: WIP, AR aging and billing controls represent a material cash-conversion risk that must improve through systems consolidation.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Increases NWC usage, debt and liquidity pressure.

case_positions.statement: The business is operationally asset-light, with capex around 1.6% of revenue.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: If capex is materially higher, free cash flow and deleveraging weaken.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Asset intensity is directly represented by capex-to-revenue assumptions.

case_positions.statement: The remaining integration program is executable only if $2.0m is funded, a dedicated leader is appointed and major cutovers are governed.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Failure can reduce revenue, margin, cash conversion and customer retention.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Integration execution is represented through integration spend and combined-risk margin and working-capital assumptions.

case_positions.statement: Management is credible, but finance, reporting and integration capability require sponsor-backed strengthening.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Weak execution governance increases integration and reporting risk.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Management capacity is qualitative; it affects CP-015 and CP-026 rather than a unique model cell.

case_positions.statement: Identified add-on acquisitions are optional upside and are excluded from the standalone base case.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Prevents unidentified M&A from masking weakness in the standalone case.

case_positions.statement: Opening first-lien debt of $42.8m is supportable on the Firm basis with at least $62.0m sponsor equity and $3.0m opening cash.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Higher leverage or lower liquidity could make the downside non-solvent.

case_positions.statement: The standalone base case supports approximately 2.00x MOIC and 14.8% XIRR at a 9.0x exit multiple.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Defines the supported base-case economics.

case_positions.statement: The standalone downside retains positive equity value and approximately 1.28x MOIC / 5.1% XIRR.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: If downside equity is impaired or liquidity fails, the investment case materially weakens.

case_positions.statement: The investment case does not rely on multiple expansion; the standalone base exits at 9.0x versus a 9.5x entry multiple.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Protects the case from requiring market rerating.

case_positions.statement: $108.0m is the maximum approved enterprise value and should not increase.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Any higher offer requires reapproval or repricing.

case_positions.statement: $12.0m of seller rollover provides meaningful continuing alignment.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Lower rollover would weaken alignment and change ownership economics.

case_positions.statement: Customer change-of-control notices, consents and termination rights must be addressed before closing.
conditions_or_resolution: Review all material contract COC terms
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Adverse response or missing consent may require repricing, condition or termination.
case_positions.notes: Underlying contracts are not included in the fixture.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Customer legal rights are a closing/gate condition; economic consequences route through CP-005 and scenario nodes after an adverse outcome.

case_positions.statement: The founder-related headquarters lease must be reset to market terms.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Avoids unnormalized related-party economics.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: The market-rate lease requirement is represented by the Firm rent-normalization adjustment.

case_positions.statement: Accepted customer and integration risks require explicit governance, monitoring and staged acquisition approvals.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Without controls, accepted risks are not bounded or observable.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Governance and monitoring controls are institutional conditions, not numerical model inputs.

case_positions.statement: Customer concentration and integration execution risks are correlated; the majority accepts the combined risk with conditions, while one IC member rejects the compensation.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Simultaneous realization can materially reduce EBITDA, increase NWC and pressure covenants.
case_positions.notes: Dissent is preserved as part of the canonical decision state.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: The correlated customer/integration risk is explicitly represented by the Combined Risk case.

case_positions.statement: Utilization must be normalized by definition before it is used to support margin improvement; seller-reported, standardized billable and standardized total-professional utilization are not interchangeable.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Using an inflated utilization definition overstates achievable margin improvement.

case_positions.statement: Commercial branding integration and operational systems integration are separate facts; the latter remains incomplete.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: Prevents a branding-level claim from closing the operational integration question.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Operational systems integration is represented by retained integration costs and capitalized integration spend.

case_positions.statement: The LBO model is internally consistent on sources and uses, balance sheets, sponsor capital and exit LTM measurement.
case_positions.decision_impact_if_false: If the model fails these controls, calculated returns and covenant outputs are not decision-ready.
case_positions.model_binding_rationale: Model-integrity position is bound to explicit model control cells and series.

SUPPORTS.meaning: Source object increases evidentiary support for the target.
SUPPORTS.traversal: support maintenance; removal may reduce target support but does not automatically recalculate values.

CONTRADICTS.meaning: Source object is materially incompatible with the target or an existing support route.
CONTRADICTS.traversal: opens contradiction or reduces target support; requires resolution rule or human adjudication.

DERIVES_FROM.meaning: Target semantics or value are defined or derived from the source object.
DERIVES_FROM.traversal: source supersession stales the target and may require recomputation.

DRIVES.meaning: Source causally affects the target state, assumption, formula selection or quantitative output.
DRIVES.traversal: propagate downstream subject to materiality, formula and human-position boundaries.

CONDITIONS.meaning: Target may be accepted, committed or remain current only while the source condition or governance requirement holds.
CONDITIONS.traversal: unsatisfied condition blocks gate or stales the target institutional state.

epistemic_status.ESTABLISHED: Sufficiently supported for the decision phase under the stated perimeter and period.
epistemic_status.CONTESTED: Material counterevidence, ambiguity or disagreement remains.
epistemic_status.OPEN: The proposition or required condition has not been resolved.
epistemic_status.UNEXAMINED: The relevant perimeter has not yet been examined.

decision_status.ACCEPTED_WITH_CONDITIONS: Adopted only subject to explicit conditions or monitoring.

freshness_status.STALE: One or more material upstream bases changed and the position has not been recomputed or re-accepted.

outcome_status.PARTIALLY_HELD: The position held only in part.
outcome_status.MATERIALIZED: The risk or failure mechanism occurred.
outcome_status.RECOVERED_AFTER_FAILURE: The position failed and was later remediated.

support_routes.description: Approval requires a credible business, acceptable revenue/customer durability, accepted earnings and working-capital bases, executable integration, supportable capital structure and returns, enforceable conditions and explicit acceptance of correlated risk.
Firm-underwritten EBITDA equals reported EBITDA plus accepted historical adjustments less Firm reserves and recurring costs.
Covenant EBITDA is supported by a distinct contractual/model definition and does not depend on the Firm valuation basis.
Tenure, breadth and monitoring conditions support base-case treatment; lack of volume protection and correlated risk prevent the position from being fully resolved.
Base returns require the accepted operating, working-capital, capital-structure and exit assumptions.
Downside resilience depends on customer reduction, integration stress, working-capital pressure and opening capital structure.

conditions.text: Purchase price based on $11.4m of Firm EBITDA.
Sponsor initial cash equity of at least $62.0m.
Opening cash at least $3.0m and revolver undrawn.
Riverton reference call and change-of-control notice completed without adverse response.
Normalized NWC target of $8.4m; unsupported aged WIP excluded.
Independent chair appointed and integration leader hired within 60 days.
$4.0m board-designated integration and liquidity capacity preserved.
Major systems cutovers require independent readiness review and fallback plan.
First add-on requires separate board approval; second add-on requires two clean operating quarters.
Monthly ultimate-parent, WIP, DSO, utilization, debt and covenant reporting.

decision_snapshot.dissent: One member rejects the investment because the 18.2% customer, incomplete integration and 9.5x entry multiple do not sufficiently compensate for correlated risk.
